quick.q: What do you never share with AI?
How do you safely get help with a personal document?
options: Replace real details with placeholders like [NAME]
Paste the whole document with all numbers
Send a photo of your ID

quick.q: Someone calls with your relative's voice and urgently asks for money. What do you do?
options: Hang up and call them yourself on a known number

quick.q: Where do you get an AI app?
options: Only from an official source (app store, official site)
From any link in a message

image.q: You're typing your card number in the highlighted box. What should you do?
The highlighted message asks for your bank password. What is it?
options: A sign of a scam – never give it

challenge.task: You need help writing a complaint to your landlord, but you don't want to reveal your name, address or rent. Write a safe prompt.
checklist: You use placeholders instead of real data
You ask for a tone and length
challenge.example: Help me write a complaint to my landlord [NAME], who hasn't fixed a water leak in the bathroom of the flat at [ADDRESS] for [NUMBER] weeks. Firm but polite tone, max 120 words.
